stories.title: BlackRock says AI agents could drive stablecoin and crypto adoption
stories.summary: BlackRock said AI agents may become major users of stablecoins and crypto payment rails. The firm called this an AI-driven trend that markets currently underappreciate. CryptoSlate put a potential market size on the idea at $5 trillion.
stories.whyItMatters: If AI agents start transacting in stablecoins, that adds a large new source of demand beyond retail speculation.

stories.title: NYSE and Blockchain.com to bring tokenized US stocks to crypto users
stories.summary: NYSE and crypto exchange Blockchain.com are working together to list tokenized versions of US stocks. The tie-up aims to give crypto-native users access to tokenized equities. Timing and which stocks will list first are not yet specified.
stories.whyItMatters: Tokenized equities on a major crypto exchange would be a concrete step toward merging traditional and crypto markets.

Regulatory sign-off for the tokenized-stock structure

stories.title: Former Hack VC partner Hsin-Ju Chuang found dead at 37
stories.summary: Hsin-Ju Chuang, a former partner at crypto venture firm Hack VC, was found dead at age 37. Her death follows a public dispute with the firm, according to CoinDesk. The cause of death and further details have not been reported.
stories.whyItMatters: The crypto VC community is small, and an unresolved dispute involving a prominent figure draws scrutiny to firm conduct and governance.

stories.title: EU watchdogs warn quantum computers could break crypto's encryption
stories.summary: European Union regulators warned that future quantum computers could break the cryptographic locks that secure digital assets. The warning flags a long-term risk to blockchain security, not an immediate threat. No timeline for when quantum computers could reach that capability was given.
stories.whyItMatters: Quantum-resistant upgrades could eventually be needed across blockchains, wallets, and exchanges that hold digital assets.
whatToWatch: EU guidance or rules on quantum-resistant cryptography
Blockchain projects' plans to migrate to quantum-safe algorithms
questions: How soon could quantum computers realistically threaten crypto keys?

stories.title: Circle launches 24/7 stablecoin FX engine to target the $10 trillion currency market
stories.summary: Stablecoin issuer Circle launched a foreign-exchange engine that runs around the clock using stablecoins. The move targets a slice of the roughly $10 trillion daily currency-trading market. It positions stablecoins as a settlement rail for FX trades beyond crypto markets.
stories.whyItMatters: A working stablecoin FX product could pull real-world currency-trading volume onto crypto rails, a key test of mainstream adoption.
whatToWatch: Which currency pairs and institutions use the new engine first
Trading volume in the weeks after launch
questions: Which banks or brokers plan to integrate the engine?
How does its pricing compare with traditional FX venues?

stories.whyItMatters: A major exchange like NYSE embracing tokenized stocks through a crypto platform signals growing institutional comfort with blockchain-based trading.

stories.title: Bitcoin's $16 billion options settlement lands with a call-heavy book
stories.summary: Bitcoin's quarterly options expiry settled about $16 billion in notional value, with more bullish call bets outstanding than bearish puts. CoinDesk also noted bitcoin is on its longest streak of a kind not seen since 2012. Separately, Cointelegraph reported bitcoin looking for support near $86,000 after oil prices dropped below $90.
stories.whyItMatters: Large options expiries and shifting support levels can move bitcoin's price sharply in the days around settlement.
whatToWatch: Bitcoin price action in the days following the expiry
Whether $86,000 holds as support
questions: What exactly is the 2012-era streak CoinDesk refers to?

stories.title: MoonPay to acquire SEC-registered North Capital in $60 million all-stock deal
stories.summary: Crypto payments firm MoonPay agreed to acquire North Capital, an SEC-registered broker-dealer, in an all-stock deal worth more than $60 million. The acquisition gives MoonPay a regulated entity already registered with US securities regulators. Terms beyond the deal value were not disclosed.
stories.whyItMatters: Buying a registered broker-dealer lets a crypto firm offer regulated, securities-adjacent products without building that licensing from scratch.

stories.title: Ex-SEC acting chair: agency dropped crypto cases to avoid credibility issues

stories.whyItMatters: Comments from a former top SEC official about why cases got dropped shed light on the agency's shifting crypto enforcement posture.

stories.title: China probes DeepSeek and Moonshot over alleged data leaks to Anthropic's Claude
stories.summary: Chinese authorities are reportedly investigating AI firms DeepSeek and Moonshot over claims that data leaked to Anthropic's Claude models, according to Decrypt. The probe concerns data handling, not any digital-asset product. Details of the alleged leak mechanism were not specified.
stories.whyItMatters: This is primarily an AI-industry story, but it touches the same AI-infrastructure debate BlackRock cited when predicting AI agents could drive crypto and stablecoin demand.

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs erase $5.7 billion outflow hole, but profit-taking caps the rebound
stories.summary: US bitcoin ETFs recovered from a $5.7 billion outflow shortfall, according to CryptoSlate. New inflows brought the funds back to even, but profit-taking by existing holders is absorbing much of the fresh demand. The net price impact from the flow reversal has been limited so far.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flows are a key gauge of institutional demand for bitcoin, and profit-taking offsetting inflows shows the rebound isn't yet translating into clean price support.
whatToWatch: Whether net ETF inflows turn sustained rather than one-off
Bitcoin's price response as flows stabilize
questions: Which ETFs drove the recovery?
How much of the profit-taking came from short-term versus long-term holders?
